A white or almost white, crys- talline powder. It shows polymorphism. Practically insoluble in water; sparingly soluble in alcohol and in acetone; slightly solu- ble in dichloromethane. Protect from light. USP 31 (Hydrocortisone). A white to practically white, odour- less, crystalline powder. Very slightly soluble in water and in ether; soluble 1 in 40 of alcohol and 1 in 80 of acetone; slightly soluble in chloroform. Store at a temperature of 25°, excursions permitted between 15° and 30°.
